name: UCSF ImmunoExplore Summer Camp
what_you_do: You can attend a free summer camp at UCSF's Parnassus campus with lectures, games, Q&A sessions, patient panels and live anatomy dissections. UCSF students and faculty mentor you.
who_can_apply: Bay Area high school students who may have limited opportunities to engage with biomedical research, per the page. Grade range and other rules are not stated.
duration: Not stated (summer camp; dates not posted)
deadline_text: The page is out of date (titled Summer Camp 2025, it says 2026 applications are open but posts no dates), so email the program through the Contact Us link before applying.
how_to_apply: Email the program first, through the Contact Us link on the ImmunoX site, because the page is out of date. The page links a Google Form for 2026 camper applications.
